name: Collection of the Corrupt Water
summary: Greta Mosshoof in Felwood asks you to bring an Empty Canteen to Jaedenar’s Moon Well. She needs water collected from the well at the heart of the corrupted place.

sections.title: At the Moon Well
sections.body: The Empty Canteen is meant for the Moon Well at Jaedenar’s center. You are to fill it there and carry it back to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood, where she awaits the water.

faq.answer: Greta Mosshoof in Felwood asks you to bring her water from Jaedenar’s Moon Well.
The Moon Well is in the center of Jaedenar.

faq.q: What do I take to the well?
faq.answer: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well and fill it there.

faq.q: Where do I bring the filled canteen?
faq.answer: Bring the filled canteen back to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

attribution: In-game quest text: Collection of the Corrupt Water
